Expected results

The PRD rule this test checks, word for word (S12-R5): “Analytics may contain predefined field keys and setting values, but no displayed record values, names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.”

  • No event sent to Google Analytics in this session (including page_view), and none of its parameters (including the page address, page_location or dl, and the address before it, page_referrer or dr), contains the customer name (Bravo Co), a technician name, the work order number, the VIN, the search text (“ZZAUTOTEST Bravo” or “ZZAUTOTEST Bravo Co”) or a dollar amount.
  • Anything that is none of these does not fail this test: the field keys and setting values the rule allows (for example board_view, total_price, on, compact, default), and the page address with no search in it (ending in /workorders).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, Confluence 845185030, version 77 (26 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S12-R5, read 27 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.

Spacing (density) steps: PRD “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, Confluence 845185030, version 73 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 — S3-R11: “Board View shows no Density control in this release (SV-11580).” S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View. Board View has no Density control in this release (S3-R11).” QA lead, 22 Oct 2026: the density step is done in Tech View.

QA lead, 27 Oct 2026: the expected results follow S12-R5 as written; a page address with no search in it is not a failure.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R5: “Analytics may contain predefined field keys and setting values, but no displayed record values, names, identifiers, search text, or dollar amounts.”
